metadata.title: Global existence of an initial boundary value problem for the Einstein equation via a Hamiltonian approach
metadata.abstract: The global existence of the initial boundary value problem for the Einstein equation in \((2+1)\)-dimension with totally geodesic timelike boundary is proved by a Hamiltonian approach. The initial boundary value problem is formulated within the framework of the ADM formalism, and the ADM reduction is carried out under the constant mean curvature spatial harmonic gauge. Deriving energy estimates for the flows in the reduced phase space shows the global existence.
